indicator_definition: Proportion of the population reporting experience of crime, violence or vandalism in their local area in the past year. Reflects perceptions of safety. Data collected through EU-SILC.
rationale: Feeling safe is a dimension of quality of life. Progress means a reduction in the share of people reporting crime or violence in their area.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through EU-SILC. Respondents asked about crime, violence or vandalism experienced in their area. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Population reporting crime, violence or vandalism in their area
graph_title: Population reporting crime, violence or vandalism in their area
